Display.Enabled: Show a customer display on a second screen (this PC)
Display.Hint: The customer sees the items, the total in dollars and pounds, what they paid and their change, and a thank-you after the sale. Nothing else from the POS is shown there.
Display.MessageHint: Shown under the logo while no sale is going on, e.g. "New collection in store". Empty shows "Welcome!".
Display.NoSecondScreen: Only one screen is connected to this PC. Plug in the customer's screen, set Windows to "Extend these displays" (Windows + P), then click Refresh.
Display.SeeYou: We hope to see you again soon
Display.TextSizeHint: Makes everything on this PC bigger or smaller: text, buttons and tables together. Anyone can also change it from their name in the side menu, or with Ctrl + and Ctrl −. A small screen only offers the sizes that still fit.
